title: Great app
body:
I’ve hated habit trackers for a long time because they force you to work around them rather than adapting to your needs.

This app is not like that.

It does everything I need without getting in my way.

Thank you to the team for your great work.
author: Melitos_M

title: Yes and no
body: Bring back single tap goal completion on Apple Watch!
author: Daniel-359

title: Support team not responding
body:
The free app does not provide basic options i.e you cannot add things as simple as notes to the habits. The edit options are very limited, tasks cannot change their categories, there are very few predefined habits.
    In addition, the support team is not responding. After starting a conversation with a request to close my account, I was reassured that I will get assistance when I state my reasons for closing the account. I sent two messages and got no response for a week. The close account button in the app does nothing and starts an endless loop. I still receive mails 3 times a day with premium offers and scoops.
author: George Hristoff

title: Awesome app
body: Really helps me track my schedule and habits.
